desc: Cheerios is a gluten-free, heart-healthy cereal made with 100% whole grain oats, providing 1.5g of soluble fiber per serving, which may help lower cholesterol as part of a balanced diet. It contains 34g of whole grains, is a good source of calcium and fiber, and includes 11 essential vitamins and minerals—all with no artificial flavors or colors. Perfect as a quick breakfast, on-the-go snack, or pantry staple, this 18 oz family-size box offers a wholesome option for the whole family.
features:
One 18 oz Family Size box of Chocolate Peanut Butter Cheerios Breakfast Cereal

The goodness of Cheerios cereal with the taste of chocolate and peanut butter

Sweetened whole grain Os with real cocoa and peanut butter for a delicious part of breakfast

Naturally flavored chocolate peanut butter cereal with whole grain oats as the first ingredient

Enjoy this toasted oat cereal with milk as part of breakfast or take along as kids snacks

Whole grain cereal box that is an official participating Box Tops for Education product
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Sugar, Peanut Butter (peanuts, sugar, monoglycerides, salt), Dextrose, Corn Starch, Corn Syrup, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Salt, Cocoa Processed with Alkali, Caramel Color, Tripotassium Phosphate, Natural Flavor. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
